title: Preserve the conceptual vocabulary and select the Case 002 editorial roadmap
objective: Preserve the owner-directed Greek and modern epistemic vocabulary as durable product-design context, synthesize the supplied Case 002 strategy and pre-research into an explicit candidate ledger, select one bounded Case 002 research direction, and sequence a small library of later cases without admitting new empirical claims or beginning Case 002 research.
required_evaluation: conceptual-vocabulary coverage and episteme-versus-truth boundary review
Case 002 candidate-ledger completeness against all supplied strategy and pre-research notes
explicit separation of editorial decision, pre-research leads, accepted evidence, and public claim admission
roadmap review for verdict-shape, audience, machinery, corpus-cost, licensing, and risk diversity
full deterministic make check with disclosure audit and unchanged generated state
independent review of the resulting documentation from a fresh clone
acceptance: a durable conceptual-vocabulary document preserves the useful Greek and modern distinctions while stating that it is product orientation rather than an authoritative history of philosophy or a How We Know case

the vocabulary distinguishes truth, world state, belief, evidence, warrant, provenance, lineage, uncertainty, suspension, understanding, skill, judgment, and wisdom and connects them to concrete product implications
a standalone case-selection record synthesizes the supplied candidate arguments and pre-research without presenting those notes as accepted evidence
Case 002 is explicitly selected as a narrow agent-citation-lineage case whose empirical unit is captured agent traces rather than papers about agents
the selection fails closed if a reproducible public trace packet cannot support the claimed URL, span, derivation, and dependence counts
a sequenced library roadmap retains the strongest non-selected candidates and varies audience, verdict shape, and machinery rather than creating a one-topic debunking series
the current public feature, accepted Case 001 dossier, research packet, policies, compiler, workflows, and generated outputs remain unchanged
make check passes without changing accepted source state
limitations: This task makes an editorial selection and preserves conceptual design context; it does not create, research, review, admit, feature, publish, or deploy Case 002.

Supplied model-generated pre-research is a lead ledger, not a source packet, citation, or evidentiary receipt; every empirical statement must be re-retrieved and verified under a later research contract.
The conceptual vocabulary does not establish a universal ontology of knowledge, settle historical interpretation, or make the word episteme a case or homepage hero.
No agent run, benchmark, medical claim, political claim, additional lens, public intake form, API/MCP activation, workflow mutation, DNS action, package publication, or release is authorized.
